answer: In a market for yarrow forecasts and cipher audits, make certified hardware the scarce harbor for reward claims. Each chip proves possession of a vendor credential and produces an epoch-specific nullifier, without disclosing its permanent ID. Accept only one claim per nullifier, across all accounts. A thousand aliases on one chip still get one slot; an attacker must acquire additional genuine chips and pay their hardware cost. This relies on secure chips and a trustworthy credential issuer.
